pathways.label: Public Secondary & Tertiary Hospitals (二级及以上公立医院)
pathways.description: Standard designated care network for students under Ping An Foreign Student Scheme. Inpatient and general outpatient departments.
uncertainties: Outpatient deductible threshold applies (typically RMB 650); special VIP wards and foreign patient wings are excluded.

pathways.label: University Health Center & Campus Clinic (校医院)
pathways.description: Primary consultations, triage, first-aid, and routine prescription services on university campus.
uncertainties: Direct billing and referral protocols depend on university arrangements.

emergency.label: Medical Emergency Ambulance in mainland China: Dial 120 immediately.
